items.normalized_text: Fail-closed conditions The run shall fail closed when
the requirements file is missing, unreadable or malformed
a mandatory requirement is silently omitted
output or evidence escapes the isolated workspace or /tmp
live-payment or provider access is requested
real secrets or real-person data are detected
tracked source is mutated by runtime execution
unsupported production-readiness or certification claims are attempted
any mandatory unsupported obligation is incorrectly reported as passed
No real customer, merchant, bank, PSP, NPCI, issuer or acquirer data
No live UPI or banking integration
No claim that deterministic classification replaces human accountability
No guarantee that every obligation can be implemented by the current deterministic generator

If the current generator cannot implement one or more mandatory depth requirements, it shall return NO_GO with an unsupported-capability report rather than generating a shallow application and declaring success
current obligations must be independently verified
applicable NPCI, RBI, bank, PSP and organisational requirements must be confirmed
security, privacy, operational and legal reviews must be completed
official certification or approval must be obtained where applicable
